description: Live property market figures for an area of Abu Dhabi from BrokersLynk: how many live listings brokers offer for 1-, 2- and 3-bed homes to buy and to rent, what the middle half of them ask, example homes (building, beds, price — never contact details), how many buyers and tenants are looking, and a link that opens the same search on brokerslynk.com, and a link that opens a WhatsApp chat with a BrokersLynk broker. Areas: Al Reem Island, Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, Al Raha Beach, Masdar City, Al Reef, Khalifa City. Without an area, every area.

area.description: An area name from the list, or its slug (e.g. yas-island).

name: abu_dhabi_market
